layout.observations: Two title lines at word boundary.

style.checked_requirement: Pure black/white flat illustration with large outlined white hands, black hardware and localized smooth white contact wear
style.observed: Lever wear is now a solid smooth white curved patch; plug is a white flat disc with black slot. Hands remain white outlined shapes and hardware predominantly solid black.
issues: Small streaked rim highlight remains on upper-left edge of lower rosette.

substantive_visual.observed: Large upper lever grip and lower inserted-key pinch remain the non-glyph scene, joined by the continuous same-door edge.

function_contact.observed: Visible upper pivot and solid lever connect the hand to door. Lower plug now has a narrow near-parallel black slit; entering key edge overlaps that slit with shaft connected to pinched bow. Traditional bulb/neck opening is gone.

hangul.observed: Title uses broad square syllables with open counters and visible word space; subtitle/body retain separate strokes and word gaps. Text stays horizontal and clear at 720px width.

information_relationship.observed: Title names the large paired motions; subtitle remains immediately below. Date/place touch the same reading column beside lower lock. Hours/free/URL retain generous lower-left space.

local_material_edge_finish.observed: Smooth lever patch leaves black outer contour intact; bow rim white arc stays exposed opposite thumb. No long shadow below lock. Hand/letter contours remain separate.
issues: Fine streaked highlight persists on lower rosette upper-left rim, unlike the fully flat contact strip.

located_observations.location: upper lever, contact area below thumb
located_observations.observation: Former brush/scratch marks are replaced by a broad unbroken white curved strip inside an intact black lever silhouette.
White oval plug with thin contour contains a narrow black slit above/below the entering blade; round bulb and flared neck are removed.
Smooth broad white edge arc remains visible, connected to shaft and pinched by thumb/index without extra digits.
A small bright streaked surface highlight remains on the black circular attachment rim.
Seven entries remain legible, including the long hours and intact URL. Title and hours wrap at the same observed boundaries with no clipping or hand overlap.
Both hand contacts, lever patch, inserted key and continuous right door edge remain recognizable. Practical copy is small at 213px width.

residuals: A small streaked highlight remains on the upper-left rim of the lower rosette; the hardware finish is not entirely flat at native detail.
The broad white lever and bow contact patches are stylized and can also be read as highlights; the illustration alone does not uniquely distinguish polish from specular shine.
At 213px thumbnail width practical copy is tiny; detailed readability was observed at 720px width.
Maximum supported tool resolution and print suitability were not established by this returned 1024×1536 PNG.
